title: The Blocked Lane
who: loader foreman at the Ring Two food stalls
want: Settle who moves a pallet of crates that is blocking the Ring Two walking lane before the crowds come off shift.
at_stake: The lane stays blocked, the stalls lose the evening trade and the Exchange sentry logs a closure notice against whoever let it stand.
complication: A hire steps across the walking lane: receiving is closed to visitors. (complications.md, standoff 5)
places: the Compact desk on Ring Two

approaches.label: Offer your crew to shift the pallet
Read the lane markings to both sides
Check the pallet tag and the notice

Offer your crew to shift the pallet.clean: the loaders and the stallholders both speak well of your crew afterwards
Offer your crew to shift the pallet.cost: your crew pays two hired hands to shift the pallet quickly
Offer your crew to shift the pallet.fail: the Exchange sentry reports your crew standing in a closed lane to the Compact desk on Ring Two

Read the lane markings to both sides.clean: the stallholders pay your crew a settling fee once the lane is clear
Read the lane markings to both sides.cost: the foreman pays your crew its fee but the sentry's note about the noise reaches the Compact desk on Ring Two
Read the lane markings to both sides.fail: your crew pays the lane fine the sentry writes up

Check the pallet tag and the notice.clean: the sentry stamps your crew as having kept the peace and the Compact desk on Ring Two hears of it
Check the pallet tag and the notice.cost: your crew pays to have the pallet re-tagged
Check the pallet tag and the notice.fail: your crew pays the sentry's re-inspection fee
